mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.writer_id, u.user_name AS writer_name, n.title, n.view_cnt, n.created_at FROM NOTICE n JOIN USERS u ON n.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC

SELECT n.notice_id, n.writer_id, u.user_name AS writer_name, n.title, n.content, n.view_cnt, n.created_at FROM NOTICE n JOIN USERS u ON n.writer_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE (notice_id, writer_id, title, content) VALUES (seq_notice.NEXTVAL, #{writerId},#{title},#{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET deleted_at = SYSDATE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
UPDATE NOTICE SET view_cnt = view_cnt + 1 WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE_READ (read_id, notice_id, user_id) VALUES (seq_notice_read.NEXTVAL, #{noticeId}, #{userId})
